scoring_justification: Full recompute (T1) is infeasible because the verifier cannot re-run the DMAREL minimization; we compare the agent's reported relaxed cell parameters and lattice energy to the paper's reference values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold relaxed cell dimensions and lattice energy for urea from DMAREL
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from Table IV of the paper, which gives percentage changes relative to experimental cell (CSD UREAXX09). The absolute relaxed values are those produced by the DMAREL code; they correspond to the paper's reported relaxed urea structure. The lattice energy U_r = -107.5 kJ/mol is directly from Table IV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: The reference solution (solve.sh) writes these exact values, which are the same as the paper's relaxed results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported relaxed results for urea, confirmed by the reference solver.

outputs.description: Relaxed unit cell parameters (a, b, c, alpha, beta, gamma) and lattice energy (U_r) for urea from the DMAREL minimization. All angles in degrees, cell lengths in Å, energy in kJ/mol.

output_contract.notes: The relaxed parameters will be compared to hidden reference values with appropriate tolerances.

steps.description: Compare reported a,b,c,alpha,beta,gamma,U_r to hidden gold within tolerances; score linearly degrades beyond tolerance.
